spec.context: RETAKE of the dark-mode reports card after fixes. Card #1A1A19, ink #F5F5F5, fee 18px bold + "Pay on collection" grey caption, status chip amber #FBBF24 on dark amber #2A1D05 (9.9:1), prep box dark amber bg + 1px bright amber border (new — separation) + amber text. Judge: all greys read on the dark card, amber chip and prep box crisp and separable from the card, hierarchy preserved, any illegibility or crowding.

measured_notes: Card bg reads #1A1A19 with #F5F5F5 title 'Blood Sugar (Fasting)' — contrast ~15:1, well above AA
Fee '₹80' is bold and the largest secondary element (~18px), title ~17-18px; hierarchy reads title → fee → details, acceptable since title is the surface's subject
'Pay on collection' grey caption (~12-13px) on dark card reads legible, estimated ~7:1 against #1A1A19
Status chip 'Placed — awaiting confirmation' amber text on dark amber chip; amber ~#FBBF24 on #2A1D05 stated 9.9:1 — AA met, chip visually separable from card

Prep box: dark amber fill with a visible 1px bright amber border and amber text — border clearly separates it from card and from chip above; text wraps fully ('Overnight fasting of 8-12 hours required'), no truncation
Body detail lines (lab name, order id, collection slot, Pune) in grey ~#B0B0AE on #1A1A19, estimated ~8:1 — AA met; order id wraps to a second line rather than truncating — honest handling
Screen gutters ~16px both sides, card internal spacing ~12px rhythm, card radius consistent ~12px
Back arrow touch target appears ~40px height — borderline, flagged as non-blocking since it is the only control and button row spacing is generous
non_blocking_notes: Back arrow target marginally under 44px; pad hit area to be safe
Large empty area below the single card is expected for one report but an empty-region caption (e.g. no further reports) would avoid a perceived dead end if more reports are expected
Prep box and chip amber are close in hue; separation now relies on the border — working, but keep chip fill slightly darker if more amber surfaces are added
verdict.one_line: Dark reports card passes: greys legible, amber chip and bordered prep box crisp and separable, hierarchy and gutters hold; only the back-arrow hit area is marginally under 44px.
